decisions.reason: Report §1 fully derives build-before-bump baking 0.3.6 into the v0.3.7 bundle, states the constant is inlined at build time and never reread at runtime, gives the corrected order with a pre-push baked-constant gate, keeps mirror verification, and correctly does not treat v0.3.8's manifest as the v0.3.7 build's version.

§2 explains client refresh shows the toggle, PNG 200 proves the route alive, SVG 404 is the running handler's old whitelist while disk already has svg, and only a host restart reloads the boot-time closure — scoped to this host's lifecycle.

§3 three-way evidence (disk clean, delivered result clean, persisted payload spliced, re-read clean) localizes corruption to upstream result-text assembly; file is innocent and must not be edited; payload treated as untrusted.

§4 gives the ordered chain: disk bytes via asset route, payload only after DOMParser parsererror check, sandboxed iframe without allow-scripts while SMIL runs, explicit error state; validation failure goes to error, not unchecked to the iframe.

§5 plus the executed forensics-demo decode all concatenated zstd frames preserving order, reconstruct the stored splice, compare against source, and prescribe the upstream bug report; checklist covers bump-before-build, shipped-constant check, per-mirror tag SHA, and plane-specific probes.

caps.reason: Final advice mandates bump-before-build, does not claim mirror repush or browser refresh repairs the defect, forbids editing the clean SVG, and renders the payload only after XML validation with scripts blocked.
